scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix functions install
scripts.dev: npm --prefix functions run build && concurrently --names functions,emulators,web --prefix-colors blue,yellow,green "npm --prefix functions run build:watch -- --preserveWatchOutput" "firebase emulators:start --only auth,functions,hosting --import=.emulator-data --export-on-exit" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run qr-key:ensure:dev && npm --prefix web run build -- --mode development && firebase deploy --project dev && gcloud run services update api --region=europe-west2 --project=repair-cafe-dev --no-invoker-iam-check --quiet
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run qr-key:ensure:prod && npm --prefix web run build && firebase deploy --project prod && gcloud run services update api --region=europe-west2 --project=repair-cafe-prod --no-invoker-iam-check --quiet
scripts.qr-key:ensure:dev: firebase functions:secrets:describe QR_SIGNING_KEY --project dev >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm run rotate-qr-key:dev
scripts.rotate-qr-key:dev: openssl rand -base64 32 | firebase functions:secrets:set QR_SIGNING_KEY --project dev --data-file - --force
scripts.qr-key:ensure:prod: firebase functions:secrets:describe QR_SIGNING_KEY --project prod >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm run rotate-qr-key:prod
scripts.rotate-qr-key:prod: openssl rand -base64 32 | firebase functions:secrets:set QR_SIGNING_KEY --project prod --data-file - --force
